acoustic_spaces.label: Dry / close
acoustic_spaces.description: No added room coloration; default for narration.

acoustic_spaces.label: Open exterior
acoustic_spaces.description: Very dry, open-air presentation with no room tail.

acoustic_spaces.label: Small stone room
acoustic_spaces.description: Subtle early reflections suggesting a chapel or small masonry room while preserving speech intelligibility.

acoustic_spaces.label: Large stone interior
acoustic_spaces.description: Restrained early reflections suggesting a nave or large masonry hall; not an authentic impulse response of a named place.

acoustic_spaces.label: Confined stone space
acoustic_spaces.description: Short, close reflections suggesting a crypt, cellar or confined masonry volume.

acoustic_usage.description: Apply one semantic acoustic space to a complete authored segment.
Use a deliberately short authored segment to make the acoustic space a brief narrative accent rather than a sustained voice effect.

sound_roles.description: A punctual sound that underlines an idea without taking over the narration.
A sound given explicit narration-free space after a segment because it carries useful information or emotion.
A sound owns foreground time, then carries under resumed narration. Schema v6 can bind the carry to measured spoken segments rather than guessed milliseconds.

bridge_carry_modes.description: Use when an absolute overlap duration is itself the artistic intent.
Carry through the measured duration of the following spoken segment(s), then optionally retain a short tail.
